title: feat(grid): a lookup chip in a list cell opens its record in the side drawer; lookup cells draw an edit button (#36015)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuLB1HMq57UcoRZFjpa8YhHZ)_

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgWkLah49N6UoD4CS3S

Fixes #36015

The card's 11:13Z revision (maintainer: 「同意，改卡」): a single click on a lookup chip opens that record in the side drawer, and a lookup cell has a pencil button. #36033 landed the rest of the card with `Refs #36015`; this PR is the lookup-cell part and closes the card.

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 列表里单击关联记录的小标签（比如联系人列表里的「客户」），右侧抽屉打开那条记录，列表不动。关掉抽屉后，滚动位置和选中的格子都还在。
- 点格子里小标签旁边的空白，只是选中这一格。一格里有几个标签，点哪个开哪个；选中后按 Ctrl+Enter / Cmd+Enter 在抽屉里开第一个；按住 Ctrl / Cmd 点，仍是新标签页整页打开。
- 关联格在鼠标移上去或已选中时，右边出现铅笔按钮，点了进入编辑（出现关联记录选择器），和双击、回车一样。没有编辑权限、字段只读、记录被锁时不出现。这个位置原来放「打开」图标，关联格不再画它。
- 人员的小标签（负责人、创建人，指向 `sys_user` 的关联）不变：单击只选中，选中后有「打开」图标，没有铅笔。邮箱、电话、网址、名称列都不变。手机上照旧整页打开。
- 抽屉的网址带上了记录和它的对象（`?recordId=…&recordObject=…`）：刷新后抽屉还在，按后退关掉抽屉，和名称列「在侧边打开」一样。
- 风险：改到五个包（字段格子、表格、网格、列表、控制台抽屉）；给宿主加了两个可选接口，不传时行为和以前完全一样；没有新文案键（铅笔用已有的「编辑」`table.edit`）。

## What changes

On a grid with the select-first cell model whose host opts in (today the console's list page), a **reference cell** is a column of `lookup`, `master_detail` or `tree` type whose `reference` is not `sys_user`.

**`@object-ui/fields`: `index.tsx`**

- `ReferencedRecordLink`'s anchor carries `data-record-object` and `data-record-id`, the record the chip names. Nothing else changes in its markup or its click.

**`@object-ui/components`: `context/gridCellSelection.tsx`, `index.ts`**

- `GridCellSelection` gains an optional `referenceCells?: GridReferenceCells | null`. `GridReferenceCells` (exported as a type) is `isReferenceColumn(columnKey)` (asked per column on every render, so it answers from the column alone) and `openRecord(objectName, recordId)`.

**`@object-ui/components`: `renderers/complex/data-table.tsx`, `dataTableCellSelection.ts`**

- New `recordChipAt` / `firstRecordChip`: the record a chip (`a[data-record-link][data-record-object][data-record-id]`) at or around the target names.
- In a reference cell, the select-first `onClickCapture` that #36033 added still cancels a plain click on the chip and selects the cell, and then calls `referenceCells.openRecord` for the chip clicked. A click beside the chips only selects. Ctrl, Cmd, Shift and Alt clicks, a non-primary button and a touch tap pass through to the link as before.
- A double-click on a reference chip does not also edit the cell (its first click opened the record).
- Ctrl/Cmd+Enter on a selected reference cell opens its first chip through `referenceCells.openRecord`; every other cell keeps #36033's behaviour.
- New `CellEditButton` in every reference cell while no editor is open: a pencil at the cell's right edge, labelled with the existing `table.edit` key, shown on cell hover (`group-hover/cell`) and while the cell is selected. Its click calls `attemptEdit`, the same gate double-click and Enter pass through. It is drawn only when `readOnlyReasonOf(row, col)` is `null`; that is asked when the pointer enters the cell and when the cell becomes selected, never per render (the `describeCell` contract). It takes no focus. A reference cell does not draw #36033's `CellOpenButton`.

**`@object-ui/plugin-grid`: `ObjectGrid.tsx`**

- New runtime prop `openReferencedRecord?: (objectName, recordId) => void`. With `cellSelection` and this prop, the grid's `GridCellSelection` carries `referenceCells`: `isReferenceColumn` reads the column's field (`opensReferenceInPlace`: lookup / master_detail / tree, reference not `sys_user`), `openRecord` is the prop.

**`@object-ui/plugin-list`: `ListView.tsx`**

- New host prop `openReferencedRecord`, handed to the grid only (`object-grid` views), as `recordLinkAdornment` is.

**`@object-ui/app-shell`: `urlParams.ts`, `views/objectViewRecordNavigation.ts`, `ObjectView.tsx`, `objectViewListRenderer.tsx`, `objectViewRecordOverlay.tsx`, `recordDrawerStack.tsx`**

- New reserved URL param `RECORD_DRAWER_OBJECT_PARAM` (`recordObject`), listed in `RESERVED_URL_PARAMS`: the object of the drawer root's record when it is not the listed object.
- `handleOpenReferencedRecord(objectName, recordId)`: the listed object's record opens as the name cell's 「在侧边打开」 icon opens it (`?recordId=` only); another object's sets `?recordId=` and `?recordObject=` (a push, so Back closes it). A chip clicked while the drawer is open swaps its root.
- `drawerRoot` is that record when `?recordObject=` names another object the console knows and the server reads one record of (`servesRecordRead`); it has no sibling set, so the drawer draws no ↑ ↓ counter. Unknown or unread object: no drawer.
- Closing the drawer, the name cell's icon and the page origin a phone redirect builds drop `?recordObject=` with `?recordId=`.
- The drawer's ⤢ at a root of another object opens that object's page (`expandedRecordPath`); the listed object's root keeps its list-relative route and origin.
- On a phone a `?recordObject=` link answers with that record's own page, as `?recordId=` does for the listed object.
- `RecordStackDrawer` takes `listObjectName`; the list marks the root's row as active only when the root is a record of the listed object.
- `ObjectView` passes `handleOpenReferencedRecord` only when its list has the drawer (`navOverlay.mode === 'drawer'`, not a phone), the same condition as `openInPanel`. A list whose rows open nothing (`none`, a list-only object) keeps #36033's behaviour: the chip only selects.

**Field types this reaches:** `lookup`, `master_detail`, `tree` drawn through `LookupCellRenderer` / `ReferencedRecordLink`, when the referenced object is routable from the list (the chip is an anchor only then). A `user` field (`UserCellRenderer`, avatars) draws no link and is untouched.

**Readings (claim A–G):**

- **A.** Only grids whose host passes `openReferencedRecord` (the console's object list). Every other host keeps #36033's behaviour.
- **B.** Ctrl/Cmd+Enter on a lookup cell opens its first chip in the drawer.
- **C.** Person cells (lookups to `sys_user`) draw no pencil and keep #36033's open button.
- **D.** A chip clicked with the drawer open swaps the drawer's root, as the name cell's icon does.
- **E.** A lookup to the listed object itself opens the listed object's drawer, with `?recordId=` alone.
- **F.** A chip with no link (unroutable, unread, restricted or name-only) only selects; an editable cell still draws the pencil.
- **G.** The drawer's record and object live in the URL, as `?recordId=` does (ui `AGENTS.md` #8).

Docs: `content/docs/frontend/plugins/plugin-grid.mdx` § On an object's list page (new bullet after the click bullet; the click bullet #36033 wrote now leaves out the lookup chip a host opens in place). #36033's changeset is untouched; this PR's own changeset says it (Notes, below).

## Notes

- **#36033's pending release note is left as it is** (`.changeset/36015-list-cell-click-only-selects.md`, restored from the base in `87d42cbd`; head `b59bf991`..`9c225b51` had added a sentence to it as a declared correction, which kept `Check Changeset` red). This PR's own note, `.changeset/36015-lookup-chip-opens-in-drawer.md`, now says what it changes about that note instead: "This replaces, for lookup chips on that page, the earlier change in this release where a plain click on a lookup chip only selected its cell." The docs bullet in `plugin-grid.mdx` keeps the L1-b N1 rewording.

## Tests

Added, each a top-level `describe` in the component's existing harness file:

- `components/src/__tests__/data-table-select-first-35684.test.tsx`, "a reference chip opens its record in place": a plain click on the chip calls `openRecord` with the chip's record, cancels the default and selects the cell, and a double-click on it opens no editor; a click beside the chip only selects, Ctrl and Cmd clicks follow the link; Ctrl+Enter opens the first chip through the host; the edit button is hidden until the pointer enters the cell, then shown on hover and while selected, opens the editor, and the cell draws no open button; a cell the host says opens no editor draws no edit button; a column the host does not name (a person) keeps the link behaviour and the open button; control: with no `referenceCells` the chip only selects and no edit button is drawn.
- `plugin-grid/src/__tests__/ObjectGrid.cellSelection-35684.test.tsx`, "a lookup chip opens its record in the host's place": through `ObjectGrid` with a routing host, the account chip carries `data-record-object` / `data-record-id` and a single click calls `openReferencedRecord('crm_account', 'a7')` without following the link; the lookup cell's edit button opens its editor and the `owner_id` (lookup to `sys_user`) cell draws none; a person chip only selects; control without the prop.
- `app-shell/src/views/objectViewRecordNavigation.listRows-27524.test.tsx`, "a lookup chip opens the record it names in the list's drawer": the URL params for another object and for the listed object, `drawerRoot` for another object (no siblings), for an unknown object (`null`) and for the listed object (siblings kept), close drops both params, ⤢ opens the other object's page.

- After L1-b's S1 (fixed in `9c225b51`: a double-click on a chip opened its record twice, so the console's router pushed the same URL twice and the first Back left the drawer open). The grid opens a chip on a click's first press only (`e.detail > 1` opens nothing), and `handleOpenReferencedRecord` returns when the URL already names that record of that object, which also covers a fast repeat click. Each test below fails without the fix:
  - `data-table-select-first-35684.test.tsx`, "a double-click on the chip opens its record once": click, click (`detail: 2`), dblclick; `openRecord` is called once and no editor opens.
  - `objectViewRecordNavigation.listRows-27524.test.tsx`, "the record the drawer already shows is not pushed again": no `setSearchParams` for the record already shown, of another object or of the listed one; the same id under another object still opens.
  - same file, "in a router: a chip opened twice (a double-click) leaves one history entry, and one Back closes the drawer": a declarative `MemoryRouter` (it pushes on every navigate, the same URL included); after two opens the URL names the record, and one `navigate(-1)` returns to `?view=all`.

No existing test was rewritten or dropped.

Local runs. First on main `8145424b` merged with #36033's head `cefd3e31`, a full `pnpm build`:

- `vitest run packages/components/`: 501 files passed. `packages/fields/`: 316 passed. `packages/plugin-grid/`: 298 passed. `packages/plugin-list/`: 181 passed.
- `packages/app-shell/` in full did not finish inside this container's 50-minute window; the parts this diff touches ran: `src/views/ObjectView*`, `src/views/objectView*`, `src/views/__tests__/recordDrawer*`, `src/views/__tests__/recordPane*`, `src/urlParams*`, `src/__tests__/`: 128 files passed.
- After #36033 merged, the change was replayed on main `dc10b3b4` as one commit (conflicts only in `objectViewListRenderer.tsx`'s memo dependencies and the two appended describes of `ObjectGrid.cellSelection-35684.test.tsx`, both sides kept), then a full `pnpm build` and `vitest run` of `components/src/__tests__/data-table*`, `plugin-grid/src/__tests__/ObjectGrid.cellSelection*`, `app-shell/src/views/objectViewRecordNavigation*`, `app-shell/src/views/__tests__/recordDrawer*` and `fields/src/`: 348 files passed (2 skipped).
- `type-check` in `components`, `fields`, `plugin-grid`, `plugin-list`, `app-shell`: exit 0 (on both bases).
- `eslint` on the changed files: 0 errors.
- `overlap-check` on the pushed head `b59bf991`: clean against `origin/main` (`dc10b3b4`, #36033 merged) and the four open PRs sharing a file (#36114, #36105, #36096, #36024).
- `87d42cbd`: `main` `6c7c6db2` merged in (clean). `check-empty-changeset` and `check-changeset-no-major`: pass. `overlap-check`: clean against `main` and #36123; #36133 (draft) conflicts only on the one-line `useMemo` dependency list in `objectViewListRenderer.tsx`, which each PR extends by one name; the second to land merges `main`.

## Verification (browser)

CRM and Todo examples (`--fresh`), Console via Vite on this tree, Chromium, 1280 light and dark, 375 light and dark. Screenshots and the journey log: project folder `build-seat1/36015/PR2/` (`after-*`, `after-journey.log`). The before state is #36033's after state (`build-seat1/36015/after-*`): a chip only selected its cell.

| Step | After |
|:--|:--|
| Contacts, hover the Account cell | pencil at the cell's right edge |
| Click the Acme Corp chip | drawer opens Acme Corp (`?recordId=…&recordObject=crm_account`), the list stays, the cell is selected |
| Close the drawer | params gone, the Account cell still selected |
| Click beside the chip | cell selected, nothing opens |
| Click the pencil | the lookup editor opens in the cell |
| Ctrl+Enter on the selected Account cell | drawer opens Acme Corp |
| Click the email text | cell selected, no navigation, open button in the cell |
| Click the name | the contact's record page |
| Todo tasks, hover the Assigned To cell (lookup to `sys_user`) | no pencil |
| Click the Dev Admin chip | cell selected, page stays, open button on hover |
| 375 | phone cards (no grid), unchanged |

## Acceptance notes

1. Click a lookup chip: the drawer opens that record, the list stays, closing it keeps scroll and selection: yes (browser).
2. Click beside the chip: the cell is selected, nothing opens: yes.
3. Hover a lookup cell: a pencil; it opens the cell's editor (the lookup picker); none on a read-only field: yes (browser for the pencil and the editor; read-only unit-pinned).
4. Person chips (owner): single click only selects: yes (browser, Todo's Assigned To, a lookup to `sys_user`).
5. Ctrl/Cmd-click a chip opens the record in a new tab: yes (the click passes through to the anchor; unit-pinned).
6. Email, phone, URL, Ctrl/Cmd+Enter on them and the name column: unchanged from #36033: yes.
7. This body lists the field types reached and the tests: above (none rewritten).
